method: Read-only source comparison against frozen C4 native Dart consumers, SSE route, worker scoping and response contracts; final module and freeze hashes read directly. Only this additive review receipt was written.
verifiedAreas: Native login fields, bearer session scope, fire-gas mode and deterministic mobile ACK identities match frozen C4 consumers.
Complete LF-delimited SSE envelopes preserve publication identities; duplicate/reverse cases target repository ordering and normalized inner cases target separate guidance guards.
Active-case SSE end or downstream disconnect stops the attempt; control order, single injection, recovery and resource deadlines remain explicit.

The selected actual voice request is held before upstream submission, or its genuine upstream response is held after one submission. Distinct successor ACKs pass through; a duplicate of the held request aborts.
JSON media type, first-seen selected ACK, finite hash-bound device clock, inject-time baseline validity and five-second observation deadline are enforced.

Submission instrumentation captures UTC before upstream.end(body) and logs the returned call with both timestamps and no server-receipt claim. Downstream finish/close metadata does not claim client consumption.
resolvedInitialFindings: Active SSE reconnect could previously continue a controlled case.
The mode allowlist previously used firegas instead of fire-gas.
A held voice request previously caused distinct successor voice-started ACKs to be rejected.
Freeze-time-only expiry checking could mask the intended map rejection at injection.
The documented JSON POST media-type restriction was previously missing.
limits: Source readiness is not an execution grant, runtime validation or product pass.
Actual installed APK identity, adopted valid baseline, post-map UI recovery, server persistence and absence of prior committed receipts require independent execution evidence.
Submission and downstream transport events do not prove receipt by the server or consumption by the APK.
Actual device behavior, native callbacks, audible speech, felt vibration and physical camera or tracking behavior remain unverified.
